lines.text: Counting every cookie is petty, don't you think?

data.define: Used for someone who makes a big deal out of small things.

example.text: Counting every cookie is petty, don't you think?

publish.title: What does "petty" mean?
publish.value: Petty = Upset about tiny, unimportant things. Example: "Counting every cookie is petty, don't you think?" (casual English).
